about_the_game:
Background

The idea for this game came to me after I completed all the achievements in Animal Well. While watching videos related to Animal Well, I realized that many players were unable to experience the game's intuitive puzzle-solving aesthetic due to control issues. I wondered if there was a platform puzzle game that could overcome this control difficulty simply by fine-tuning the commands. So, my puzzle game, where you input commands to jump through platforms, might be a solution.

Features

  • Unique Command-Controlled Gameplay

Instead of directly controlling your character, you write "action scripts" to complete levels, offering an unprecedented way to solve puzzles.

  • Gradually Unlock New Commands

From movement and jumping to sprinting, double jumping, and pushing boxes, continuously expand your command set to unlock more creative solutions.

  • Brain-Turning Level Design

Precise timing, interlocking mechanisms, and traps make every attempt challenging and rewarding.

  • Endless Debugging Fun

Refine your scripts like a programmer, and complete levels with the fewest steps or the most ingenious methods.

  • A fusion of platforming and programming logic.

Combining the thrill of an action game with the challenge of logical reasoning, this game is the perfect blend of both.

  • Suitable for all types of players.

Whether you're a puzzle expert, a programming enthusiast, or an explorer seeking unique gameplay, you'll find something fun here.

short_description: In this unique command-driven puzzle platformer, you don't directly control your character. Instead, you write an "action script" for it, acting like a "programmer." Your character will strictly follow the script to navigate traps, avoid enemies, and unlock mechanisms.
